content:
There are \(6\times 6\times 6 = 216\) interior boxes that initially have no exposed face.

One full plate can touch at most two \(6\times 6\) layers of interior boxes, so it can expose at most  
\[
2\cdot 36 = 72
\]
interior boxes. Thus \(2\) plates can expose at most \(144<216\) interior boxes, so at least \(3\) plates are needed.

Three plates suffice: place horizontal plates between layers \(2\)-\(3\), \(4\)-\(5\), and \(6\)-\(7\). Then every box in layers \(2\) through \(7\) touches a plate, while layers \(1\) and \(8\) have outer exposed faces.

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
